summary: Huntsman Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a merger-of-equals agreement with Olin Corporation. Under the all-stock deal, Huntsman will merge into Olin or its subsidiaries, with Olin surviving. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction. Consideration is Olin common stock; no per-share price, premium, or dollar value stated. The merger may be structured as a direct merger or two-step subsidiary mergers, subject to Olin shareholder approval (two-thirds supermajority) and other conditions. What to watch: regulatory clearance timeline and potential competing bids.
